item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-24
item.description:
Do this week

  • Anthropic (Sep 23): Claude agents discovered ART (array-associated reverse transcriptases) — CRISPR-like DNA-repeat system in phages; ~950 agents / 210M tokens / 21h with high-level human direction + wet-lab follow-up. Preprint + new Anthropic life-sciences lab. Primary: anthropic.com/news/claude-discovers-novel-enzyme-system
  • GitHub Copilot code review (Sep 23, GA): personal Code Review settings on every Copilot plan (Business/Enterprise included) — auto-review on PR create/coauthor/ready-for-review, optional auto-review on new pushes and drafts, default effort Lite|Balanced. Enterprise admins can set org-wide default review effort (Lite/Balanced/GitHub default) with org/repo overrides.
  • Copilot for JetBrains 1.18 (Sep 22): AI-assisted tool approvals + persistent per-tool MCP controls; toggle built-in GitHub MCP without touching custom servers.

Watch

  • Agent-fleet science signal: ART run used ~950 parallel agents — useful framing for corp agent orchestration cost/observability, not a reason to drop human gates near IaC/secrets.
  • Price/perf follow-through: Opus 5.5 + GPT-6 Sol/Luna still rolling into Copilot/Bedrock — watch real $/merged PR under usage-based billing, not list rates alone.

item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-23
item.description:
Do this week

  • Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 (Sep 22): first Claude 5.5 model — claims Fable 5.1-level work at ~40% lower run cost vs Opus 5. List price $4 / $20 per MTok (cache reads $0.20, 60% cheaper); >30% faster output. Live on Claude Platform, AWS (incl. Bedrock), Google Cloud, Azure. Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 “coming weeks.”
  • GitHub Copilot: Opus 5.5 rolling out for Pro+/Max/Business/Enterprise across VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, coding agent, Mobile, etc. Usage-based at provider list pricing. Business/Enterprise: new models auto-enable unless model policy default is off or this model is disabled.
  • OpenAI GPT-6 Sol + Luna (same day, ~90 min later): Sol $2 / $10, Luna $0.10 / $0.50 per MTok (50% under GPT-5.6 promo). Sol for coding/agentic; Luna for high-volume clerical. API + ChatGPT Work/Codex; Luna also Free/Go desktop.

Watch

  • Google AX (open-source Apache 2.0): Kubernetes-style orchestrator for long-running agent sandboxes (Task/Workspace/Gateway/Model) — corp fleet compute primitive, not a hobby LangGraph substitute.
  • Price-war signal: cheaper Opus + Sol/Luna same day after both labs talked “pacing the frontier” — watch real $/completed coding job, not list rates alone.

item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-22
item.description:
Do this week

  • xAI Grok 4.7 (Sep 21): longer multi-step coding/knowledge work at Grok 4.6 prices — $2 / $6 per MTok standard; faster variant $4 / $12. Available via xAI API, Cursor, Grok Build, and third-party routers. Company claims stronger self-verification on long tasks; independent Terminal-Bench figures disagree with xAI’s xHigh listing — treat $/completed job, not headline token rate.
  • GitHub Copilot: Grok 4.7 rolling out across VS Code / JetBrains / CLI / cloud agent / Enterprise — usage-based at provider list pricing. Copilot Business/Enterprise admins: new models auto-enable unless model policy default is off or this model is disabled.
  • Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 (Sep 21): open-weights Pro (≈1T sparse MoE / 42B active) + Flash (309B / 15B active), 1M ctx, text/image/video/audio; RL code + envs published; API prices held at V2.5; UltraSpeed hosted tier claimed up to 20× output speed.

Watch

  • Cloudflare “Agent Development Lifecycle” stack push (@cloudflare/ci on Workflows, agent traces, preview-per-agent) — industry “software factory” narrative; useful framing for CI/observability, not a reason to drop human gates near IaC/secrets.
  • Frontier pricing/perf noise: Grok 4.7 vs Claude/GPT class on Terminal-Bench — watch independent evals before budgeting agent loops.

item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-21
item.description:
Do this week

  • StepFun Step 5 Preview (Sep 20): 600B sparse MoE (27B active), 1M context, image input; API open same day at $1 / $2.70 per MTok (95% cache discount). Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 44 (≈ Kimi K3 Max). Open weights promised Oct 15 — HF repo is a placeholder until then.
  • Alibaba Qwen weekend: Qwen-Audio 3.1 Realtime Plus (262K ctx, full-duplex voice + tools) on Model Studio; Qwen-Image-2.1 (native 2K + transparent editing, research license — commercial needs a separate deal).
  • Shanghai AI Lab Atria Dawn Preview (Sep 20): agentic GLM-5.2-based weights (MIT) with plan→code→experiment loop baked in; API + SGLang/vLLM paths — text-only, no images/PDFs.

Watch

  • OpenAI confirms weeks of AI-safety coordination talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind (Sep 15) after Amodei’s frontier “pacing” essay — voluntary standards talk, not a product ship.
  • Frontier pricing watch: Step 5’s $1/$2.70 vs GPT-5.6-class rates keeps token-cost pressure high for coding agents even when the headline is “popular AI.”

item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-18
item.description:
Do this week

  • Plugin4Shell (Air, Sep 17): zero-click SHA-pinning bypass RCE via plugin auto-update — Claude Code / Codex / Copilot / Gemini CLI. Patch Claude Code ≥2.1.179 and Codex ≥0.146.0; inventory plugins/skills; treat marketplace add-ons like packages (allowlist). Copilot still unpatched for non-GitHub marketplace hosts (Bitbucket/self-hosted).
  • Tighten Copilot enterprise-managed agent permissions on TF/secrets repos (ask/deny shell + network); managed rules cannot be bypassed — pair with plugin allowlists so agents cannot pull unvetted add-ons.
  • Near IaC/secrets: no auto-approve for agent shell, MCP installs, or plugin updates; fold review wait + tokens into $/merged PR as agents scale.

Watch

  • Copilot code review shell tools + Lite ensemble (Sep 11): review agents run builds/tests behind firewall — higher privilege near secrets/IaC.
  • Anthropic CI 25× in six months — plan test-selection capacity for 10–20×.
  • Sourcegraph Agentic Batch Changes GA / Coder Agents GA — pay-per-merged-changeset and corp-ready self-hosted execution; still no unsupervised auto-merge.

item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-17
item.description:
Do this week

  • Copilot code review got shell tools + ensemble Lite: review agents can run builds/tests behind the agent firewall — treat review as higher privilege near secrets/IaC; fold review wait and tokens into $/merged PR.
  • Still: enterprise-managed Copilot agent permissions — ask/deny shell + network on TF/secrets repos; app-code can stay looser. Managed rules cannot be bypassed.
  • Gate agent MCPs/skills/plugins like packages (allowlists); agents pull dependencies without a human in the loop.

Watch

  • GitHub HydraFusion research preview: cascade/critique routing for quality at ~36–67% lower estimated cost vs Opus 5 — model-neutral task-shape routing for token-cost standards.
  • Sourcegraph Agentic Batch Changes GA (Cloud now; self-hosted with 8.0): pay per merged changeset; agent reacts to CI failures — no unsupervised auto-merge.
  • Coder Agents GA + Agent Relay for Claude Code (Sep 15): corp-ready self-hosted execution with RBAC/audit; Relay still early access.
  • Anthropic CI 25× in six months — plan test-selection capacity for 10–20× as agents scale.

item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-16
item.description:
Do this week

  • Copilot enterprise-managed agent permissions: for TF/Scalr + secrets repos, require approval (or block) on shell + network; app-code can stay looser.
  • Keep premium/agentic models off-by-default pending metered pilots; use Auto Efficiency for autocomplete-shaped work.
  • As coding agents grow, treat CI wait as part of $/merged PR — no auto-approve on IaC/secrets.

Watch

  • Anthropic CI scale story (agentic coding straining CI) — plan capacity for 10–20×.
  • OpenAI “software factory” multi-agent review patterns (contrast only; they have unlimited tokens).
  • Atlassian governed agent loops (early access).
